svg.title: Skyclause architecture
svg.desc: Six stages, read from the top. Watch: the JPS rain gauge, MET Malaysia warnings and forecasts and the DOE APIMS haze index; Rapid Rail and venue listings are not built yet. Ingest: Cloud Scheduler starts adapter jobs on Cloud Run, which publish to Pub/Sub, and the worker writes the readings. Decide: for each declared window the clause engine gives a verdict in CEL, and Gemini on Vertex AI drafts the call into a bundle. Approve: a person on the rota approves, edits or rejects in the web app, with alerts and Cloud Tasks deadlines. Notify: an email notice through Resend, an ICS conditions calendar and subscriber pages; signed webhooks and share cards are not built yet. Record: an append-only, hash-chained ledger, ledger checks and a grade the next morning, all in Postgres 18 on Neon. Beside them, the Gemini Enterprise pilot: a phone camera page and a Raspberry Pi 5 post to Apps Script, which fills Sheets and Drive; the Gemini Enterprise workflows are not built yet.
